name: JEE Main-style

coverage.note: Pattern and marking from the NTA JEE (Main) 2025 Information Bulletin. Difficulty, format and topic counts from Lumi's analysis of 8 of 19 JEE Main 2025 shifts (599 questions); Lumi covers 108 of 174 shifts 2017–2026. Verified 29 Oct 2026 against the cited sources.

sections.name: Section A – MCQ (20 per subject)
sections.style: single correct of 4; includes statement, assertion–reason and match-the-list formats

sections.name: Section B – Numerical value (5 per subject)
sections.style: answer rounded to the nearest integer

pattern.notes: All 75 questions compulsory since 2025 (2021–2024 offered 10 numerical per subject, answer any 5). Negative marking applies to Section B too.

difficulty.basis: JEE Main 2025: 162 easy / 360 medium / 77 hard of 599 questions in 8 analysed shifts (Lumi). Easy share by year: 29% (2017), 27% (2020), 34% (2021), 33% (2022), 34% (2023), 36% (2024), 27% (2025), 26% (2026); hard 10–15% every year.

topics.subject: Physics
topics.name: System of Particles and Rotational Motion

notes: 2025 formats: single correct 58%, numerical value 20%, diagram based 7%, two statements 4%, match the list 4%, assertion–reason 2% (Lumi).
Skills tested in 2025: multi-step 41%, calculation 25%, application 13%, conceptual 12%, recall 6%.
Mathematics was the hardest subject in most analysed 2025 shifts (up to 12 hard of 25); Chemistry and Physics had few hard questions.
77% of 2025 questions repeated an exact idea from an earlier analysed year; 23% tested a new idea.

traps: Section B answers must be rounded off to the nearest integer (NTA bulletin).
Negative marking (−1) applies to Section B numerical questions as well as MCQs.
Two-statement and match-the-list items where one wrong pairing changes the option.
Long Mathematics calculations eat time; skip and return.
